origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends): a Gemini model signs its tool call; the client is given the signature with the call and sends it back with the call in its next request, which the relay is given as extra_content, as Google's OpenAI-compatible API writes it (the model's thinking is lost without it, and Gemini 3 refuses the request). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
